An '''election''' for the role of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was held by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]] [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> The sitting chancellor, [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], won a second four-year term by a slim margin.<ref name="Characters" /> Around the time of the election, many members of the Senate had doubt's about Valorum's leadership. Several opposition parties began drawing up lists of possible replacements, many of which suggested [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="NEC" />&mdash;one of Valorum's oldest friends<ref name="Characters" />&mdash;as a candidate.<ref name="NEC" />

As he commenced his second term, Valorum increasingly relied on Palpatine's counsel, unaware of the senator's [[Grand Plan/Legends|true intentions]].<ref name="Fact File 56">{{FactFile|56|VAL 1-4|Finis Valorum}}</ref> Palpatine would later orchestrate a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] against Valorum in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], ousting him from office. Palpatine was victorious in the subsequent [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|election]]. Valorum's victory in 36 BBY would later be mentioned in a [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|historical document]] compiled by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Federation]] [[Historical Council]] by [[36 ABY]].<ref name="NEC" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Finis Valorum's re-election to the office of Supreme Chancellor was first referenced in the [[2002]] sourcebook ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Characters" />
